definitions.explanation: The place where one was born or grew up.

examples.japanese: {故郷|こきょう}を{離|はな}れて10{年|ねん}になる。
examples.english: It's been 10 years since I left my hometown.

examples.japanese: {故郷|こきょう}が{懐|なつ}かしい。

notes:
READINGS:
- {故郷|こきょう}: formal/literary
- {故郷|ふるさと}: poetic/emotional
- Both written with same kanji

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {故郷|こきょう}に{帰|かえ}る: to return home
- {故郷|こきょう}を{離|はな}れる: to leave hometown
- {故郷|こきょう}が{懐|なつ}かしい: to miss one's hometown
- {第二|だいに}の{故郷|こきょう}: second hometown

RELATED WORDS:
- {地元|じもと}: local area, hometown (casual)
- {出身地|しゅっしんち}: place of origin (formal)
- {田舎|いなか}: countryside, rural hometown

KANJI: {故|こ} (old/reason) + {郷|きょう} (village/home).
